svg.title: Cs3Cu2Cl5 TEM panel a, rounded projected features
svg.desc: Qualitative flat outlines of rounded dark projections visible in TEM panel a, whose caption identifies Cs3Cu2Cl5. Adjacent HRTEM and FFT panels are not reconstructed as particle or atomic geometry. No scale or abundance is encoded.
svg.text: Rounded projected contrast; HRTEM/FFT panels b–c are not shape-reconstructed.
QUALITATIVE SOURCE-PANEL INTERPRETATION · NOT TO SCALE · NO PARTICLE COUNTS OR DIMENSIONS
